name: VQGAN+CLIP
tagline: The image machine of 2021, from before diffusion: it **pushes pixels around until an old vision model agrees they match your words**. Grainy, smeared, over-detailed, strange. It can **start from a picture and mutate it**, which is how album and piece covers are grown from Zvoid's own.

params.name: prompt
params.default: a luminous creature of gas and light in a black void
params.help: Several ideas can be separated with | and each is pulled toward.

params.name: init_image
params.label: Picture to start from (optional)
params.help: The picture is mutated toward the words instead of being grown from noise.

params.name: keep
params.help: How strongly the starting picture is held on to. 0 lets it dissolve completely.

params.name: size
params.help: Pixels on each side that the machine works at.

params.name: save_side
params.help: The picture is enlarged to this for the file.
